rationale: Nathanaël and Miguel share deep embedded systems expertise but come at it from complementary angles—Nathanaël as a CTO building hardware-software integration across Python, MATLAB, and VHDL, and Miguel as a robotics and firmware engineer with hands-on experience in real-time operating systems and hardware bring-up. Miguel's current focus on robotics control software and full-stack infrastructure, combined with his experience at NVIDIA and Cisco, could offer fresh perspectives on scaling embedded solutions, while Nathanaël's production CTO experience at ceepia could ground Miguel's ambitious robotics work in real-world constraints.
intro_message: Nathanaël BLAVO-BALLARIN, meet Miguel Villa Floran — both of you work at the embedded-systems and hardware-software integration layer, and could swap lessons on bridging firmware, robotics, and production IoT challenges.
